title: Interoperability register
note: Only what has been run and has evidence in this repository. A product that is not listed here has not been tested. Each entry names how to reproduce it and a file that must exist.

entries.peer: OCUDU gNB with srsUE (srsRAN 4G in 5G SA mode) over ZeroMQ
entries.what: NG Setup accepted (PLMN 00101, TAC 7), registration with 5G-AKA, security mode, PDU session, ping 5 of 5 through the user plane; five runs in a row
entries.limits: srsUE cannot decipher 5G NAS with NEA1 to NEA3 (the sequence number is read from the 4G position), so the demo configures NEA0 with NIA2; DEMO_CIPHERING=NEA2 for a UE that implements TS 33.501

entries.core: Open5GS 2.8.0 core with our AMF in its place
entries.what: registration, authentication, security mode, PDU session through the Open5GS SMF and UPF, release and de-registration (recorded trace)
entries.limits: the recorded scenario S3; one UE

entries.core: Open5GS 2.8.0 AMF with our SMF and our UPF in its place
entries.what: PDU session establishment and release with PFCP between our SMF and our UPF, GTP-U through our UPF (recorded trace)
entries.limits: the recorded scenario S3; one UE

entries.what: EAP-AKA' authentication against our AUSF: key derivation, AT_MAC and AT_RES verified by an independent implementation
entries.limits: stock UERANSIM 3.3.0 rejects the AT_KDF attribute of a conforming server (Length 1, RFC 5448 3.2); the copy built by build_ueransim_eap.sh accepts it

entries.kind: gNB + UE emulator (the project's own ORAN_emulator, N2 / NAS / N3 stack)
entries.peer: ORAN_emulator n2_attach_test, n2_register_test, n2_session_test, n2_teardown_test, n2_multi_test
entries.what: NG Setup, registration with 5G-AKA and security mode, PDU session through SMF, PCF and UPF, GTP-U uplink and downlink (ICMP echo), release and de-registration; 16 UEs at once over one association, each with its own echo reply; our own counters agree
entries.limits: the emulator's N2, NAS and N3 drivers; its DPDK fronthaul and PHY layers are not part of this run. Found: the emulator's RAN node name had an underscore (not allowed in PrintableString), and its drivers never answered the Initial Context Setup Request that carries only a registration accept; both fixed in the emulator

entries.peer: g5c-tester: scripted gNBs and UEs of this project
entries.core: Open5GS 2.8.0 (AMF, AUSF, UDM, SMF, UPF, unmodified)
entries.what: registration, 5G-AKA, security mode, PDU session and de-registration of 5 UEs at a core that is not ours; found and fixed that the scripted UE sent non-cleartext IEs in its first Registration Request (Open5GS rejects it, TS 24.501 4.4.6)
entries.limits: registration, sessions and de-registration only; Open5GS chooses NEA0 where ours chooses NEA2; 5 UEs, one gNB

entries.core: our UDM, UDR and PCF in their place
entries.what: Open5GS authenticates and sets up sessions against our UDM and UDR; Open5GS SMF takes policy from our PCF and follows a mid-session policy change with a PFCP update
entries.limits: scenarios S3 and S4 of the oracle

entries.what: the same requests to both cores, answers compared field by field; every difference has a stated reason
entries.limits: what the nine differential tests send; free5GC is not a reference

not_tested: any commercial gNB or O-RAN radio unit
srsRAN Project gNB (OCUDU is the gNB tested)
